chars.AHMED: AHMED: a slim young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black cargo trousers and a small black backpack.
chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a young man wearing a red-and-black checked flannel shirt over a white t-shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.SARA: SARA: a young woman wearing a lilac puffer vest over a white long-sleeve top and beige wide trousers.
chars.NADA: NADA: a young woman wearing a teal denim jacket, a long black skirt and white sneakers.
chars.MEN: VILLAGE MEN: a group of Amazigh village men all wearing identical plain white djellabas and yellow leather babouche slippers.
chars.OLD: OLD MAN: an old village man in a white djellaba with a brown wool burnous over his shoulders, holding a wooden cane.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night in a tiny stone-and-clay mountain village in the Atlas near Agadir. AHMED, YOUSSEF, SARA and NADA stand at the open entrance of a huge glowing wedding tent, seen from behind and the side, wide-eyed and amazed. Inside the tent, rows of VILLAGE MEN dance face to face holding curved ceremonial daggers up in the air, lanterns and carpets everywhere.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a big Amazigh wedding tent at night lit by lanterns: two facing rows of VILLAGE MEN in white djellabas dance in sync, raising curved silver ceremonial daggers above their heads, one man beating a large round frame drum, mysterious intense atmosphere, carpets on the ground.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At the tent entrance at night, AHMED leans close and whispers nervously into YOUSSEF's ear with a worried face, YOUSSEF looks back terrified and sweating; behind them blurred dancing figures in white and a warm glow.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The four friends AHMED, YOUSSEF, SARA and NADA stand frozen and hesitant right in the doorway of the glowing wedding tent at night, the girls holding the boys' arms, nobody daring to step inside, a dark mountain village behind them.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the wedding tent near the entrance, the OLD MAN stands still and stares suspiciously straight ahead with narrowed eyes and a stern frown, leaning on his cane, lantern light on his face, dancing silhouettes behind him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the tent entrance at night, AHMED steps toward the OLD MAN with a hand on his chest and an awkward polite smile, asking a favour, SARA behind him; the OLD MAN looks at him blankly, clearly not understanding a word.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AHMED, YOUSSEF, SARA and NADA step together into the lantern-lit wedding tent, excited and curious, AHMED leading with a confident grin, the others following, carpets and decorations around them.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the lantern-lit wedding tent everything has stopped: the VILLAGE MEN in white djellabas stand completely still, the drummer frozen with his hand in the air, and every head is turned toward AHMED, YOUSSEF, SARA and NADA who stand in the middle of the tent with shocked awkward faces.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close view of AHMED, YOUSSEF, SARA and NADA huddled together, terrified and sweating, eyes wide, while the silent VILLAGE MEN in white djellabas slowly gather in a circle around them staring, lantern light, tense mysterious mood.
